package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io/fs"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"path"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/pb33f/go-yaml"
	"github.com/pb33f/libopenapi/datamodel"
	"github.com/pb33f/libopenapi/index"
)

type (
	resourceFS struct {
		documents  map[string][]byte
		mu         sync.Mutex
		admissions map[*index.SpecIndex]resourceAdmission
	}
	resourceAdmission struct {
		uri           string
		contentSHA256 string
		owner         *index.Rolodex
	}
	resourceFile struct {
		*bytes.Reader
		uri       string
		data      []byte
		idx       *index.SpecIndex
		resources *resourceFS
	}
)

var (
	_ index.RolodexFS    = (*resourceFS)(nil)
	_ index.RolodexFile  = (*resourceFile)(nil)
	_ index.CanBeIndexed = (*resourceFile)(nil)
	_ fs.File            = (*resourceFile)(nil)
)

func loadResources(pairs []string) (*resourceFS, error) {
	resources := &resourceFS{documents: map[string][]byte{}, admissions: map[*index.SpecIndex]resourceAdmission{}}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for i := 0; i < len(pairs); i += 2 {
		uri, err := url.Parse(pairs[i])
		if err != nil || !uri.IsAbs() {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("resource URI must be absolute: %q", pairs[i])
		}
		if uri.Fragment != "" || strings.Contains(pairs[i], "#") {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("resource URI must not contain a fragment: %q", pairs[i])
		}
		identity := *uri
		identity.Scheme = strings.ToLower(identity.Scheme)
		identity.Host = strings.ToLower(identity.Host)
		key := identity.ResolveReference(&url.URL{}).String()
		if seen[key] {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("duplicate resource identity: %q", pairs[i])
		}
		seen[key] = true
		data, err := os.ReadFile(pairs[i+1])
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read resource %q: %w", pairs[i], err)
		}
		if _, err := parseResource(data); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse resource %q: %w", pairs[i], err)
		}
		resources.documents[pairs[i]] = data
	}
	return resources, nil
}

func parseResource(data []byte) (*datamodel.SpecInfo, error) {
	// The document parser's bypass mode permits fragments but also tolerates
	// malformed bytes. Validate syntax first without requiring an OpenAPI root.
	var syntax any
	var syntaxErr error
	if json.Valid(data) {
		syntaxErr = json.Unmarshal(data, &syntax)
	} else {
		syntaxErr = yaml.Unmarshal(data, &syntax)
	}
	if syntaxErr != nil {
		return nil, syntaxErr
	}
	info, err := datamodel.ExtractSpecInfoWithDocumentCheckSync(data, true)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if info == nil || info.RootNode == nil || len(bytes.TrimSpace(data)) == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty document")
	}
	return info, nil
}

// Open serves only explicitly admitted identities and never performs network I/O.
func (r *resourceFS) Open(name string) (fs.File, error) {
	data, ok := r.documents[name]
	if !ok {
		return nil, &fs.PathError{Op: "open", Path: name, Err: fs.ErrNotExist}
	}
	return r.newResource(name, data), nil
}

// GetFiles gives each document-build owner independent indexing handles.
func (r *resourceFS) GetFiles() map[string]index.RolodexFile {
	files := make(map[string]index.RolodexFile, len(r.documents))
	for uri, data := range r.documents {
		files[uri] = r.newResource(uri, data)
	}
	return files
}

func (r *resourceFS) newResource(uri string, data []byte) *resourceFile {
	return &resourceFile{Reader: bytes.NewReader(data), uri: uri, data: data, resources: r}
}

// Index uses the public format-aware parser and caller-owned index configuration.
func (f *resourceFile) Index(config *index.SpecIndexConfig) (*index.SpecIndex, error) {
	info, err := parseResource(f.data)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	owned := *config
	owned.SpecInfo = info
	want, err := contentHash(info.RootNode)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	idx := index.NewSpecIndexWithConfig(info.RootNode, &owned)
	got, err := contentHash(idx.GetRootNode())
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if idx.GetSpecAbsolutePath() != f.uri || idx.GetRolodex() != config.Rolodex || config.Rolodex == nil || got != want {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("resource admission changed identity, owner or contents: %s", f.uri)
	}
	// Indexing and any library callbacks finish before taking the evidence lock.
	// The map associates admission with this exact returned index/build owner.
	f.resources.mu.Lock()
	f.resources.admissions[idx] = resourceAdmission{uri: f.uri, contentSHA256: want, owner: config.Rolodex}
	f.resources.mu.Unlock()
	f.idx = idx
	return idx, nil
}

// GetIndex returns this build owner's completed index.
func (f *resourceFile) GetIndex() *index.SpecIndex {
	return f.idx
}

// GetContent returns the supplied bytes unchanged.
func (f *resourceFile) GetContent() string {
	return string(f.data)
}

// GetContentAsYAMLNode parses JSON or YAML through the public document parser.
func (f *resourceFile) GetContentAsYAMLNode() (*yaml.Node, error) {
	info, err := parseResource(f.data)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return info.RootNode, nil
}

// GetFileExtension returns the detected serialization format, not the URI suffix.
func (f *resourceFile) GetFileExtension() index.FileExtension {
	if json.Valid(f.data) {
		return index.JSON
	}
	return index.YAML
}

// GetFullPath preserves the caller's retrieval identity.
func (f *resourceFile) GetFullPath() string {
	return f.uri
}

// GetErrors returns no deferred errors; parsing and indexing return them directly.
func (f *resourceFile) GetErrors() []error {
	return nil
}

// WaitForIndexing is synchronous because Index completes before returning.
func (f *resourceFile) WaitForIndexing() {
}

// Name returns the final URI path segment for the filesystem interface.
func (f *resourceFile) Name() string {
	return path.Base(f.uri)
}

// ModTime is unspecified for explicitly supplied immutable bytes.
func (f *resourceFile) ModTime() time.Time {
	return time.Time{}
}

// IsDir reports a document file.
func (f *resourceFile) IsDir() bool {
	return false
}

// Sys carries no operating-system metadata.
func (f *resourceFile) Sys() any {
	return nil
}

// Size returns the exact byte length.
func (f *resourceFile) Size() int64 {
	return int64(len(f.data))
}

// Mode reports read-only regular storage.
func (f *resourceFile) Mode() fs.FileMode {
	return 0o444
}

// Stat returns this resource's filesystem metadata.
func (f *resourceFile) Stat() (fs.FileInfo, error) {
	return f, nil
}

// Close owns no external resources.
func (f *resourceFile) Close() error {
	return nil
}

func contentHash(node *yaml.Node) (string, error) {
	var value any
	if err := node.Decode(&value); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return hash(data), nil
}

func (r *resourceFS) inspect(role string, root *index.SpecIndex) ([]resourceEvidence, error) {
	if root == nil || root.GetRolodex() == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s motor index unavailable", role)
	}
	identities := make([]string, 0, len(r.documents))
	for uri := range r.documents {
		identities = append(identities, uri)
	}
	slices.Sort(identities)
	evidence := make([]resourceEvidence, 0, len(identities))
	for _, uri := range identities {
		count := 0
		var admitted, indexed string
		for _, idx := range root.GetRolodex().GetIndexes() {
			if idx.GetSpecAbsolutePath() != uri {
				continue
			}
			r.mu.Lock()
			admission, ok := r.admissions[idx]
			r.mu.Unlock()
			if !ok || admission.uri != uri || admission.owner != root.GetRolodex() || idx.GetRolodex() != admission.owner {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s resource lacks admission for actual build owner: %s", role, uri)
			}
			got, err := contentHash(idx.GetRootNode())
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			if role == "unresolved" && got != admission.contentSHA256 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s resource contents changed: %s", role, uri)
			}
			admitted, indexed = admission.contentSHA256, got
			count++
		}
		if count != 1 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s resource not admitted exactly once: %s (count %d)", role, uri, count)
		}
		evidence = append(evidence, resourceEvidence{Role: role, URI: uri, ContentSHA256: admitted, IndexedContentSHA256: indexed})
	}
	return evidence, nil
}
